name: phosphatidylinositol glycan anchor biosynthesis class A

function.text: PIGA encodes phosphatidylinositol N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase subunit A. Annotated molecular activities include UDP-glycosyltransferase activity and phosphatidylinositol N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase activity. It participates in GPI anchor biosynthetic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked); multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 2 (x-linked).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: PIGA encodes phosphatidylinositol N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase subunit A. It is a catalytic subunit of the glycosylphosphatidylinositol-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase (GPI-GnT) complex that catalyzes the transfer of N-acetylglucosamine from UDP-N-acetylglucosamine to phosphatidylinositol and participates in the first step of GPI biosynthesis.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked); multiple congenital anomalies-hypotonia-seizures syndrome 2 (x-linked).
